name: Castle Kitchens
introDiscord:
Beyond the chapel lies an enormous royal kitchen.

Copper pots hang from the ceiling, ovens line the walls, banquet carts
float between preparation tables, and several Octopuses have made
themselves suspiciously comfortable among the cookware.

Shizuki appears to have attempted cooking here.

There are scorch marks underwater.

Do not ask.

taxkeeper-offices-approach.prompt: Castle Kitchens opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A pantry still contains preserved restorative herbs.

Shizuki labeled the jar:

'Cooking ingredient.

Also medicine.

Today we choose medicine.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
An Octopus rises from inside an enormous soup pot wearing the lid like
a helmet.

forward.message:
A royal dessert cabinet contains Star Candies.

Finally.

The important archive.

taxkeeper-offices-depths.prompt: Deeper within Castle Kitchens, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
One Berry rests alone in Shizuki's ruined cooking pan.

Her note:

'ROYAL BERRY STEW — ATTEMPT ONE.

Ingredients:
Berry.

Instructions:
unknown.

Result:
still Berry.

Cooking successful.'

right.message: A banquet preparation chest contains preserved Star Candies.

forward.message:
An Octopus has claimed an entire rack of cookware.

It is holding eight utensils.

You have two hands.

Unfair.

taxkeeper-offices-threshold.prompt: Near Grand Banquet Kitchen, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: Another Octopus emerges wearing a chef's bowl.

right.message:
Shizuki's restorative bottle reads:

'Cooking accident medicine.

Quantity produced suggests pattern.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A royal dessert trolley still contains sealed Star Candies.

boss-antechamber.name: Grand Banquet Kitchen
boss-antechamber.prompt: The grand kitchen doors slam open.

bossPromptDiscord:
The grand kitchen doors slam open.

Pots, pans, ladles, plates, and serving trays begin moving all at once.

At the center, an enormous Octopus rises from the royal cauldron holding
eight pieces of cookware like ceremonial weapons.

Use /yes to enter the Grand Banquet Kitchen or /no to
respect the head chef.

bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Grand Banquet Kitchen. The royal challenge will wait.
completionText:
The kitchen settles.

Shizuki's final recipe remains pinned to the wall:

'Cooking Is Not Alchemy.

Apparently.

Still investigating.'
